notes: Waiver-type Exhibit A with one column per fund (General, Street, Sewer, Water, ARPA, Park). Sewer and Water columns are business-type; General, Street, ARPA, Park governmental. Rows 44, 45 and 48 (Electric Utility, Solid Waste, Water) are in the General Fund column and are kept governmental by the column rule. Beginning balances (line 3) include investments (Street 13,437.70 only; Sewer 35,391.22, Water 54,118.91 are in business-type beginning); ending investments are in line 27 (Street 13,748.54, Sewer 36,210.60, Water 54,599.08) and are inside the ending balances, so investment fields are null. County treasurer balances (533.91 at 10/1/24 and 1,659.23 at 9/30/25) are not part of line 24 and are excluded. No balance sheet statement; balance_sheet built from ending balances (line 26-28, all funds incl. utilities); debt outstanding of 541,458.17 (p3 schedule) is not a printed liability on the statement and is not included, so total_liabilities is null. Transfers (32,800 in; 20,000 out governmental, 12,800 out business-type) tie to the interfund transfer schedule (p3). Governmental identity: 150,076.57 + 299,436.49 - 286,935.73 + 32,800.00 - 20,000.00 = 175,377.33. Business identity: 199,999.92 + 1,637.33 - 38,056.00 - 12,800.00 = 150,781.25.
